edition: Latin–English column of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_latin: Clementine Vulgate (Vulgata Clementina), as displayed on the Saints.Bible staging comparison pages

verses.latin: Senior Electæ dominæ, et natis ejus, quos ego diligo in veritate, et non ego solus, sed et omnes qui cognoverunt veritatem,
verses.english: The elder to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth—and not I alone, but also all who have known the truth—

verses.latin: propter veritatem, quæ permanet in nobis, et nobiscum erit in æternum.
verses.english: because of the truth that remains in us and will be with us forever.

verses.latin: Sit vobiscum gratia, misericordia, pax a Deo Patre, et a Christo Jesu Filio Patris in veritate, et caritate.
verses.english: May grace, mercy, and peace be with you from God the Father and from Christ Jesus, the Father’s Son, in truth and love.

verses.latin: Gavisus sum valde, quoniam inveni de filiis tuis ambulantes in veritate, sicut mandatum accepimus a Patre.
verses.english: I rejoiced greatly that I found some of your children walking in truth, just as we received a commandment from the Father.

verses.latin: Et nunc rogo te domina, non tamquam mandatum novum scribens tibi, sed quod habuimus ab initio, ut diligamus alterutrum.
verses.english: And now, lady, I ask you—not as though writing a new commandment to you, but the one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.

verses.latin: Et hæc est caritas, ut ambulemus secundum mandata ejus. Hoc est enim mandatum, ut quemadmodum audistis ab initio, in eo ambuletis.
verses.english: And this is love: that we walk according to his commandments. For this is the commandment, that you walk in it, just as you heard from the beginning.

verses.latin: Quoniam multi seductores exierunt in mundum, qui non confitentur Jesum Christum venisse in carnem: hic est seductor, et antichristus.
verses.english: For many deceivers have gone out into the world who do not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh. Such a person is the deceiver and the antichrist.

verses.latin: Videte vosmetipsos, ne perdatis quæ operati estis: sed ut mercedem plenam accipiatis.
verses.english: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what you have worked for, but receive a full reward.

verses.latin: Omnis qui recedit, et non permanet in doctrina Christi, Deum non habet: qui permanet in doctrina, hic et Patrem et Filium habet.
verses.english: Everyone who departs and does not remain in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

verses.latin: Si quis venit ad vos, et hanc doctrinam non affert, nolite recipere eum in domum, nec Ave ei dixeritis.
verses.english: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house or give him a greeting.

verses.latin: Qui enim dicit illi Ave, communicat operibus ejus malignis.
verses.english: For whoever greets him shares in his evil works.

verses.latin: Plura habens vobis scribere, nolui per cartam et atramentum: spero enim me futurum apud vos, et os ad os loqui: ut gaudium vestrum plenum sit.
verses.english: Although I have much to write to you, I did not wish to do so with paper and ink. For I hope to be with you and speak face to face, so that your joy may be complete.

verses.latin: Salutant te filii sororis tuæ Electæ.
verses.english: The children of your chosen sister greet you.
